audit.whatIsWrong: Level-chart stages carried a closing verdict that contradicted the stage owner (for example a stage marked Cassiopeia ending "Camille is favoured here").
audit.why: The full-layer phase text was templated; the tail sentence was never reconciled with phases[].side, so the written verdict and the chart disagreed on the same page.
audit.corrected: Each phase why now closes with the verdict that matches its own side field, so early / mid / side-lane ownership reads consistently.

audit.why: Spike stages line up with the real kits: Camille at 2 (Hookshot, 16s at rank 1), 6 (The Hextech Ultimatum, 140s at rank 1) and her Sheen item; Cassiopeia at Petrifying Gaze (120/100/80).

audit.whatIsWrong: The Level 6 stage told you to "use the cast's brief untargetable frame" on The Hextech Ultimatum to dodge Cassiopeia's key spell.
audit.why: Riot's own description of The Hextech Ultimatum is "Camille dashes to target champion, anchoring them to the area" — there is no untargetable window. The kit file's untargetable/channel flags on R are tooltip-parse misfires and contradict the description.
audit.corrected: The stage now says the dash grants no immunity and keys R to being spent after the enemy spell rather than into it.

audit.whatIsWrong: No Grievous Wounds timing is stated even though Cassiopeia sustains through chip damage.
audit.why: Cassiopeia heals through Twin Fang (E) per Riot's ability text, which decides every extended trade against Camille's short-trade pattern.
audit.corrected: Anti-heal timing should be named on the page; I did not have a length-legal slot to add it without cutting verified text, so it is raised here.

edits.before: Hookshot (E) unlocks your wall-dash stun and attack-speed burst. Only take a wall trade when Cassiopeia's Miasma is down, then peel out on the bonus move speed before he answers. Cassiopeia is favoured here.
edits.after: Hookshot (E) unlocks your wall-dash stun and attack-speed burst. Only take a wall trade when Cassiopeia's Miasma is down, then peel out on the bonus move speed before she answers. Cassiopeia is favoured here.

edits.before: The Hextech Ultimatum (R) isolates a target in a 1v1 they cannot leave. Use the cast's brief untargetable frame to dodge Cassiopeia's Miasma or burst, then focus the trapped target. Cassiopeia is favoured here.
edits.after: The Hextech Ultimatum (R) isolates a target in a 1v1 they cannot leave. The dash grants no immunity, so spend R once Cassiopeia's Miasma is gone, not into it, then focus the trapped target. Cassiopeia is favoured here.

edits.before: Level 1-2 is hers — Noxious Blast (Q) out-ranges your single ability and hands her move speed to disengage, so don't walk up for a cs into her poke. Farm with Precision Protocol last-hits and let your passive Adaptive Defense shield soak a poison tick on the rare step-in. Don't trade until you have Q rank-2 and a point in W, or you just feed her free poison stacks and her Twin Fang (E) ramp for nothing.
edits.after: Level 1-2 is hers — Noxious Blast (Q) out-ranges your single ability and hands her move speed to disengage, so don't walk up for a cs into her poke. Farm with Precision Protocol last-hits and let your passive Adaptive Defenses shield soak a poison tick on the rare step-in. Don't trade until you have Q rank-2 and a point in W, or you just feed her free poison stacks and her Twin Fang (E) ramp for nothing.

notes: Camille kit file flags R as channel/interruptible and untargetable; both contradict Riot's own description (a dash plus an anchoring zone) and were treated as tooltip-parse misfires, per the kit README. Packet win rate 51.79% over 195 games.
